name: tangola
author: raikan10
description: Tangola: Intelligent meeting assistant for Tamil transcription and automatic English translation. Effortlessly record and summarize your Tamil meetings into English in real-time.

scripts.dev:engine: npm run prepare-engine && NODE_ENV=development DEBUG_ENGINE=true concurrently "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && electron ."
scripts.build:electron: npm run prepare-engine && npm run build && electron-builder
scripts.build:mac: npm run prepare-engine && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:mac-dir: npm run prepare-engine && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --dir -c.mac.identity=null
scripts.build:mac-fast: export CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false && export CSC_SKIP=true && npm run prepare-engine && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:win: npm run prepare-engine -- win32 x64 && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Tangola needs access to your microphone to record and transcribe your meetings.
